description: This file defines the StrandsAgentsProcessor class, which integrates Strands Agents into the Pipecat framework for conversational AI. It manages both single-agent and multi-agent graph interactions, handling message processing, streaming responses, and usage metrics.

classes.name: StrandsAgentsProcessor
